processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Fast cooling by air assisted spraying cooling suppresses austenite decomposition and κ precipitation in Fe–28Mn–8.5Al–1C–1.2Si; κ precipitates from the austenite matrix only when the cooling rate is slower than -4.4 °C/h.

structures.overall_structure: Fast-cooled Fe–28Mn–8.5Al–1C–1.2Si retains austenite (γ); κ-carbide precipitation is suppressed.

interfaces.phase_evolution: Austenite (γ) decomposes to κ-carbide only when the cooling rate is slower than -4.4 °C/h; fast cooling (air assisted spraying) suppresses this decomposition and retains austenite.

characterization_methods.technique: Schematic temperature–time transformation (TTT) style diagram of γ-phase decomposition
characterization_methods.purpose: Illustrate γ-phase decomposition and κ precipitation of Fe–28Mn–8.5Al–1C–1.2Si during cooling
characterization_methods.key_findings: κ precipitates from the austenite matrix when the cooling rate is slower than -4.4 °C/h; the fast-cooling side contains gamma and gamma+kappa' fields, while the slow-cooling side contains gamma+kappa*, gamma+kappa*+alpha(E2/DO3) and gamma+kappa+B2/DO3.

analytical_models.equation_role: Empirical prediction of austenite decomposition during aging/slow cooling: γ → γ′ + γ″ → γ′ + L12(SRO) → γ + κ

parameters.name: critical cooling rate below which κ precipitates

analytical_models.model_note: Composition validity range: Mn 12–30 wt%, Al up to 12 wt%, C 0.6–2.0 wt%; Fe–28Mn–8.5Al–1C–1.2Si falls within this range.

unmapped_findings: Figure 3 (b0048) caption writes the alloy as Fe–28Mn–8.5Al–1C–1.2S, a typographical error for Fe–28Mn–8.5Al–1C–1.2Si.
On the fast-cooling side of Figure 3, the reaction fields are '1: gamma' and '2: gamma+kappa''; the right-hand ordered-phase bar marks B2, B2+DO3 and DO3 ranges.
The paper is a review; no sample-specific tensile, hardness, density, or other mechanical property values are reported for the fast-cooled Fe–28Mn–8.5Al–1C–1.2Si condition.
